title: Transfer: Transit Reliability Metric Comparison
goal: Given yearly rail-network reliability KPIs for late departures and missed connections, compute a trend for each KPI and report which metric is worsening faster, including its slope and p-value.
skillBenefitRationale: This transfers the skill to transit operations and changes the task shape from one series to a small KPI comparison, but the deciding step remains trend estimation and significance-based interpretation.
